declaration.preface: Skypass Travel recognizes that procurement decisions have a direct impact on the environment, society, and economy. As a travel services provider, we aim to integrate sustainability into our procurement practices by selecting suppliers and products that align with ethical, social, and environmental standards. This policy outlines our commitment to responsible procurement, promoting supplier collaboration, reducing environmental impact, and supporting ethical and fair business practices across our supply chain.
declaration.declaration:
The purpose of this policy is to:

Establish clear guidelines for sustainable procurement across the company.

Promote responsible sourcing of goods and services while minimizing environmental and social impacts.

Ensure compliance with ethical and sustainability standards among suppliers and partners.

Support Skypass Travel’s overall ESG commitments and long-term sustainability goals.

Skypass Travel is committed to sustainable procurement practices that balance environmental, social, and economic considerations. We prioritize suppliers who demonstrate environmental stewardship, uphold ethical labor practices, promote diversity and inclusion, and provide products or services that reduce resource use, waste, and emissions.
declaration.scope: This Sustainable Procurement Policy applies to all operations, business functions, and services of Skypass Travel Inc. (Group) across all locations worldwide, including corporate offices, registered offices, branch offices, subsidiaries, joint ventures, and all associated supply chain activities. It is applicable to all employees, workers, contractors, and stakeholders engaged with Skypass Travel Inc. (Group), directly or indirectly, and requires strict compliance and accountability at every organizational level.

Our Procurement Prioritize: Prioritize ethical and responsible sourcing in all procurement activities.
Ensure that suppliers comply with environmental, labor, and human rights standards.
Foster partnerships with suppliers who implement sustainable practices and minimize environmental impact.
Support local and small businesses to strengthen community engagement and drive economic growth.
Promote waste reduction and circular economy principles throughout the procurement process.
Champion sustainable procurement practices and encourage suppliers to adopt eco-friendly initiatives.
General Targets: We aim to integrate sustainability principles into every procurement decision, considering environmental, social, and ethical impacts.
All suppliers must formally acknowledge and sign the Supplier Code of Conduct, committing to uphold ethical, environmental, labor, and human rights standards.
We will encourage suppliers to adopt sustainable practices, including energy efficiency, resource conservation, and ethical labor standards.
We are going to promote digital procurement processes to reduce paper and operational impact.
We will foster collaboration with suppliers to co-create sustainable solutions and share best practices.
We will conduct annual self-assessment and on-site audits of key suppliers to assess adherence to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards and identify improvement opportunities.
We will monitor and report procurement sustainability KPIs annually, including energy use, emissions, waste reduction, ethical compliance, and supplier performance.
Sustainable Sourcing & Environmental Ste: We are willing to prioritize suppliers that implement water and energy efficiency practices in their operations.

Aim to prioritize and collaborate with suppliers holding recognized ISO certifications (such as ISO 14001 for environmental management or ISO 50001 for energy management) to encourage best practices in sustainability.
We aim to promote suppliers who monitor and reduce greenhouse gas emissions in their operations.
We will support procurement choices that optimize resource efficiency, including reusable, durable, or modular products.
Equip all procurement staff with knowledge and skills to consider environmental impacts, resource efficiency, and sustainable practices in procurement decisions.
Ethical and Inclusive Procurement: We aim to work only with suppliers who ensure safe working conditions and fair wages.

Aim to prioritize suppliers holding ISO certifications related to social responsibility (e.g., ISO 45001 for occupational health & safety or SA8000 for social accountability) to ensure compliance with labor and human rights standards.
We will promote gender equality and diversity in supplier organizations.
We are going to engage suppliers who support community development initiatives, education, or social welfare programs.
We will encourage suppliers to report and manage social risks across their operations.
We aim to train all procurement personnel on labor rights, ethical sourcing, and human rights risks associated with procurement decisions.
Economic and Strategic Value: We are willing to develop long-term partnerships with suppliers committed to sustainability, ensuring shared value creation.

Prioritize suppliers holding ISO certifications relevant to ethical practices and social responsibility (e.g., ISO 37001 for anti-bribery, ISO 26000 guidance on social responsibility) to strengthen ethical compliance across the supply chain.
Aim to train all procurement personnel to identify, assess, and mitigate ethical risks, including labor rights, anti-corruption, and responsible sourcing practices.
We are going to prioritize procurement decisions that reduce total cost of ownership rather than short-term price savings.
We will support local suppliers in emerging markets to strengthen regional economic development.

targets.target: By 2030, at least 7% of all key suppliers will undergo formal ESG assessments, including on-site audits and self-assessment questionnaires
We will reduce paper consumption in procurement activities by 10% by 2030 through digitalization
By 2030, at least 35% of key suppliers must have signed the Supplier Code of Conduct
By 2030, at least 10% of total procurement spend will be directed toward ISO-certified suppliers
We are going to source at least 12% of office consumables from suppliers using recycled or sustainable materials by 2030
We will reduce carbon footprint associated with supplier logistics by 10% by 2030 through strategic sourcing and consolidation
Ensure 50% of procurement personnel complete training on environmental sustainability and responsible sourcing by 2030, with refresher programs conducted annually.
We are going to achieve 12% digital invoicing and ordering with suppliers by 2030 to minimize paper and administrative impact
By 2030, at least 12% of total procurement spend will be with suppliers holding relevant labor and human rights certifications
We are going to increase procurement from women-owned or minority-owned suppliers to at least 10% of total spend by 2030
Aim to ensure 50% of procurement staff complete training on labor and human rights issues by 2030, with annual refresher sessions to maintain awareness and compliance.
By 2030, at least 10% of total procurement spend will be allocated to ISO-certified suppliers with verified ethical and social responsibility standards
We will review supplier performance against sustainability criteria annually for at least 75% of top-tier suppliers.
Ensure 50% of procurement staff complete ethics and responsible procurement training by 2030, with annual refresher courses to maintain awareness and compliance.

responsibilities.duty: The governance of Skypass Travel Inc.’s Sustainable Procurement Policy will be overseen by the Sustainability Manager. This role is responsible for ensuring that all procurement and sourcing activities adhere to sustainable and ethical practices. The manager will collaborate with internal teams, suppliers, and partners to encourage responsible purchasing, implement best practices, and align procurement operations with the company’s sustainability goals. Regular training, policy reviews, and performance assessments will be conducted to drive continuous improvement. This role ensures that sustainability is fully integrated into Skypass Travel Inc.’s procurement strategies and long-term sourcing decisions.
Approve the sustainable procurement strategy and allocate resources.
Provide oversight to ensure sustainability objectives align with corporate strategy and ESG commitments.
Review major supplier contracts and high-risk procurement decisions from a sustainability perspective.
Monitor supplier compliance with sustainability standards.
Track procurement KPIs and prepare progress reports.
Conduct employee training on sustainable procurement practices.
Coordinate internal audits and implement corrective actions.
Review and update the Sustainable Procurement Policy annually to ensure alignment with evolving corporate goals, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
Provide guidance on improvements to procurement strategies and supplier engagement to enhance sustainability outcomes.
Integrate sustainability criteria into sourcing and supplier selection.
Evaluate suppliers against environmental, social, and ethical standards.
Maintain records of sustainability performance and progress toward targets.
Collaborate with suppliers to achieve environmental and social objectives.
Follow sustainable procurement guidelines in day-to-day activities.
Support eco-friendly purchasing decisions.
Report any non-compliance, risks, or improvement suggestions.
Participate in awareness and training programs related to sustainable sourcing.
Comply with environmental, social, and ethical standards.
Provide required sustainability documentation and certifications.
Actively work on improvements in environmental and social performance.
Participate in training, audits, or capacity-building programs as requested.
Track procurement spend with sustainable suppliers.
Evaluate the cost-benefit of sustainable sourcing initiatives.
Integrate sustainability KPIs into financial reporting and analysis.
Implement and maintain e-procurement systems, digital invoicing, and paperless processes.
Support transparency and reduce environmental impact of procurement operations.

policy.monitoring:
Skypass Travel is committed to transparent reporting of sustainable procurement performance. The Sustainability & Compliance Team will collect and analyze data on supplier compliance, sustainable spend, eco-certified products, and progress toward quantitative targets. Annual reports will be shared with senior management, departmental heads, and employees to ensure accountability. Key performance metrics, including supplier ESG scores, digital procurement adoption, and sustainable sourcing percentages, will be tracked and communicated to stakeholders. Reporting insights will support decision-making, continuous improvement, and strategic procurement planning.

Skypass Travel will periodically review its procurement practices to ensure alignment with emerging sustainability trends and regulatory requirements. Feedback from employees, suppliers, and other stakeholders will be actively considered to enhance procurement processes. The company will also encourage innovation and collaboration with suppliers to improve both environmental and social performance. Lessons learned from audits, reporting, and supplier evaluations will be applied to continuously refine procurement strategies and drive progress toward sustainability targets.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed annually, or sooner if significant operational, regulatory, or industry changes arise by Sustainability Officer. Progress toward the 2030 sustainability targets will be systematically monitored and reported to ensure accountability and transparency. Any updates or revisions will be communicated to all employees, suppliers, and stakeholders to maintain awareness and alignment with the company’s sustainability objectives.
